original_value: A fictional 27-inch desktop display built for immersive color work and smooth motion, featuring an OLED panel, 2560x1440 resolution, 240Hz refresh rate, and adaptive sync support. The monitor includes HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort inputs, a fully adjustable stand, and factory-calibrated sRGB and DCI-P3 modes for creative workflows and gaming alike.
